description: EXACT convention-D (Jones/Temperley-Lieb) closed form of the A=4 4-component Brunnian Markov-trace deficit D_4 = 1 - tau_4 as a rational function of h = q - 1/q, in the SAME convention as the Lean A=3 object tauBorromean = (4+h^2-3h^4-h^6)/(h^2+4) (BorromeanMarkovTrace.lean / BorromeanFrobeniusReconstruction.lean). Convention D uses SIGNED chi_lambda and Temperley-Lieb weights y_{(a,b)} = [a-b+1]_q/[2]_q^n with y_lambda=0 for >=3-row diagrams (only the SU(2)-surviving 2-row diagrams contribute), NOT the production |chi|-with-Wenzl-y convention (which lives in s=sqrt(q)). All exact sympy over Q(q); ZERO float64. A=3 leg validates the convention by reproducing tauBorromean exactly before A=4 is touched.
q0AnchorReason: Evaluates at the PROTON pin, but from a rational hardcoded in this file rather than from q_parameter: sp.Rational(2584370278640139188197914756009, 2328306436538696289062500000000) = 1.1099785827513805166..., which agrees with the canonical proton pin 1.1099785827513808075... to 16 significant digits and then diverges, relative deviation 2.62e-16. The denominator is 2^8 * 5^40, i.e. a decimal-exact rational built from a ~17-digit decimal string, so it is not Fraction(float64) but carries float64 precision. That is inside the 1 ppQ (1e-15) L1 target and far below this probe's own comparison resolution (producer_tauL4 = 1.000145898, 9 digits), so no conclusion here depends on it. The field name q0_pin_exact_rational is exact about the rational, not about the pin.
outcome_a_means: D_4 is a clean rational function of h alone (like A=3)
outcome_b_means: D_4 genuinely depends on s=sqrt(q) (NOT the case here)

A4_result.note_convention_difference: The committed producer a4_brunnian_deficit_closed_form.py uses the PRODUCTION mass convention g=Σ y_λ^Wenzl·|χ_λ| (half-integer q-powers, deficit rational in s=√q). This script uses convention D (the Lean tauBorromean frame: signed χ, Temperley-Lieb weights, 2-row diagrams only), which is rational in h. The two conventions AGREE at leading Milnor order/coefficient (topological μ̄-invariant) but DIFFER at subleading order and at q0.
